question: Estimate the profitability of a fintech lending app in India (e.g., a personal loan platform).
idealClarificationQuestions: Personal loan / BNPL fintech (Slice, KreditBee class)? Yes.
FY26 — post-RBI tightening of digital lending? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Net Interest Margin (NIM) on disbursed loans: ~14-18% (high-yield personal loans 24-36% APR, cost of funds 11-13%).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Many lending fintechs are loss-making after credit costs.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Net Interest Margin (NIM) on disbursed loans
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~14-18% (high-yield personal loans 24-36% APR, cost of funds 11-13%).

calculationFlow: Fee income (processing + late fees): ~2-3% of disbursed.
Net margin: -2% to +5% (highly volatile based on NPA cycle).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Net margin: -2% to +5% (highly volatile based on NPA cycle).
